dct_description_sm:
Overview

This feature service provides parcel-level cadastral information for the District of Peachland area within BC. It includes legal parcel boundaries and related land reference information used to support property lookup, boundary interpretation, and land administration workflows.

Content

  • Parcel polygons and linework representing land parcels and associated cadastral boundaries.
  • Property reference attributes such as civic address details, parcel identifiers, legal plan references, lot and block information, land district information, zoning, assessed use, and neighbourhood context.
  • Land and parcel descriptors including parcel size, area, vacancy status, and waste collection day where available.

Geographic Coverage

The service covers The Distrcit of Peachland in British Columbia.

Use Cases

  • Viewing parcel boundaries and legal cadastral references.
  • Supporting property and land title lookups.
  • Identifying parcel location, address, and legal plan details.
  • Assisting with planning, zoning review, and municipal property inquiries.

Source and Use Notes

Published by the GIS Section of the Regional District of Central Okanagan under the RDCO Open Data License and related terms of use. Distances and areas are approximate and should be used as reference information.
